post.description: Sends a transactional email from Customer.io.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

transactionalMessageId.description: The transactional message template to use. You can supply the numeric template ID or the trigger name.

identifiers.description: Identifies the person represented by your transactional message by exactly one of id, email, or cio_id.

identifiers.id.description: Use the customer's ID identifier when your workspace identifies people by ID.

identifiers.email.description: Use the customer's email identifier when your workspace identifies people by email.

identifiers.cioId.description: Use the immutable Customer.io person identifier.

from.description: The verified sender address that the email is from.

subject.description: Overrides the transactional template subject line.

body.description: Overrides the transactional template HTML body.

messageData.description: Key-value pairs referenced by liquid in your message.

language.description: Overrides language preferences for the recipient.

sendAt.description: Unix timestamp determining when the message will be sent.

sendToUnsubscribed.description: If false, the message is not sent to unsubscribed recipients.

disableMessageRetention.description: If true, the message body is not retained in delivery history.

queueDraft.description: If true, the message is queued as a draft instead of sent immediately.

fakeBcc.description: If true, Customer.io sends per-recipient copies instead of true BCC copies.

replyTo.description: The address that recipients can reply to.

preheader.description: Preview text shown next to or under the subject line.

attachments.description: A dictionary of attachments keyed by filename with base64-encoded contents.

headers.description: A JSON string containing an array of header objects.

disableCssPreprocessing.description: If true, disables CSS preprocessing for the email.

tracked.description: If true, Customer.io tracks opens and link clicks in your message.

deliveryId.description: A unique identifier for the queued delivery.

queuedAt.description: Unix timestamp when Customer.io queued the message.

post.description: Sends a transactional SMS from Customer.io.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

transactionalMessageId.description: The transactional message template to use. You can supply the numeric template ID or the trigger name.

to.description: The phone number to send the SMS to in E.164 format, or a liquid reference.

identifiers.description: Identifies the person represented by your transactional message by exactly one of id, email, or cio_id.

identifiers.id.description: Use the customer's ID identifier when your workspace identifies people by ID.

identifiers.email.description: Use the customer's email identifier when your workspace identifies people by email.

identifiers.cioId.description: Use the immutable Customer.io person identifier.

from.description: The verified phone number or sender ID that the SMS is from.

language.description: Overrides language preferences for the recipient.

messageData.description: Key-value pairs referenced by liquid in your message.

sendAt.description: Unix timestamp determining when the message will be sent.

sendToUnsubscribed.description: If false, the message is not sent to unsubscribed recipients.

disableMessageRetention.description: If true, the message body is not retained in delivery history.

queueDraft.description: If true, the message is queued as a draft instead of sent immediately.

deliveryId.description: A unique identifier for the queued delivery.

queuedAt.description: Unix timestamp when Customer.io queued the message.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
